lead.event: MSCI's proposed downgrade of Indonesia prompts market reactions
lead.headline: MSCI downgrade proposal could prompt US$5.6 billion in outflows
lead.blurb: MSCI is consulting on downgrading Indonesia from Emerging Market to Standalone Market status. Goldman Sachs estimates the move could prompt US$5.6 billion in outflows, with a further US$2.7 billion at risk if FTSE takes similar action. MSCI says its concerns are about the overall condition of Indonesia’s capital market, including enforcement against manipulation and coordinated trading. Indonesia has until 30 April 2027 to show sustained improvement, with MSCI’s decision expected before 30 June 2027.
lead.copy_decision: rewritten: moved from flash to lead

market_structure_policy.event: Bank Indonesia lowers bank reserve requirements
market_structure_policy.headline: Bank Indonesia cuts reserve requirements in stages, expects a net Rp90 trillion liquidity release
market_structure_policy.blurb: Conventional banks’ reserve requirements fall from 9% to 8% on 1 November and 7% on 1 December; sharia banks’ rates drop from 7.5% to 6.5% and then 5.5%. BI also cuts its liquidity incentive from 6% to 5% on 1 December while keeping the BI-Rate at 5.75%.

market_structure_policy.event: OJK imposes capital-market fines and sets payment deadline
market_structure_policy.headline: OJK imposes record Rp2.52 trillion in capital-market fines
market_structure_policy.blurb: As of 16 October, principal fines included Rp1.5 trillion for Dian Swastatika Sentosa share-trading violations, Rp500 billion involving Barito Renewables’ IPO allocation, and Rp100 billion in Petrindo Jaya Kreasi’s IPO allocation case. OJK said it may pursue criminal elements with the Indonesian National Police if parties miss payment deadlines.
market_structure_policy.copy_decision: rewritten: moved from flash to story

market_structure_policy.event: Government plans to hand over Papua gold mine to Antam
market_structure_policy.headline: Government plans to hand over 275.36-hectare Papua gold mine to ANTM
market_structure_policy.blurb: The government revoked Kristalin Eka Lestari’s mining permit on 12 October and shut down its 275.36-hectare site on 22 October. Antam is planned to manage the area as both operator and investor.

earnings_guidance.headline: PGUN reports 33.53% nine-month profit growth
earnings_guidance.blurb: Pradiksi earned Rp135.44 billion for the period ended 30 September, up from Rp101.43 billion a year earlier, while basic earnings per share rose to 23.61 from 17.68. Net sales increased 5.25% to Rp566.1 billion, and PGUN shares rose 3.75% to Rp8,300 in morning trading after the results.

earnings_guidance.event: Bank Mandiri reports nine-month 2026 profit growth
earnings_guidance.headline: BMRI reports 20.7% nine-month profit growth
earnings_guidance.blurb: Bank Mandiri's consolidated net profit reached Rp45.5 trillion through September, supported by healthy loan growth, rising digital transactions and improved productivity. Bank-only loans grew 16% to Rp1,605.8 trillion, while the cost-to-income ratio fell to 36.1% from 43%.

earnings_guidance.headline: AKRA reports Rp2.21 trillion in nine-month 2026 net profit
earnings_guidance.blurb: AKR Corporindo's revenue rose 43.63% to Rp46.53 trillion, with fuel and basic chemicals trading and distribution accounting for more than 90% of sales and growing 41.90%. Industrial estate revenue increased 143.60% to Rp2.72 trillion.

earnings_guidance.event: Darma Henwa reports Q3 margin and 2027 profit outlook
earnings_guidance.headline: DEWA reports 33% Q3 EBITDA margin, BRI Danareksa projects Rp1.64 trillion profit in 2027
earnings_guidance.blurb: Darma Henwa's fleet internalization lifted the margin from 29.6% in Q2, while quarterly EBITDA rose 27.5% to Rp626 billion. BRI Danareksa also projects 2027 revenue of Rp11.78 trillion, up from its 2026 estimate of Rp7.22 trillion.

deals_control.event: PACK plans rights issue to fund nickel acquisitions
deals_control.headline: PACK plans Rp8.19 trillion rights issue for two nickel acquisitions
deals_control.blurb: Abadi Nusantara shareholders who do not exercise their rights could face dilution of up to 74.6%. The planned issue of up to 100 billion shares at Rp10 each would fund loan repayment, working capital and acquisitions of Denway Development Limited for US$324 million and Bumanik for US$79 million. The plan requires shareholder approval and an effective OJK registration statement.
deals_control.copy_decision: rewritten: moved from lead to story

deals_control.event: Beruntung Berkat Sejahtera negotiates to acquire control of STRK
deals_control.headline: Beruntung Berkat Sejahtera negotiates to acquire 61.87% of STRK
deals_control.blurb: Beruntung Berkat Sejahtera signed a conditional Indicative Terms and Conditions agreement with Barito Mas Sukses on 21 October. It is negotiating to buy 6.63 billion STRK shares, equal to 61.87% of the company. The proposed acquisition is subject to further due diligence and a definitive sale and purchase agreement, and would make Beruntung Berkat Sejahtera STRK’s controlling shareholder.
deals_control.copy_decision: rewritten: 1 new articles with a new fact: The parties signed a conditional Indicative Terms and Conditions agreement on 21 October 2026.

deals_control.event: Adhi Karya schedules shareholder meeting on divestment and proceeds
deals_control.headline: ADHI schedules 13 November meeting on JMJ divestment and rights issue proceeds
deals_control.blurb: Adhi Karya will seek shareholder approval to divest its holding in affiliate Jasamarga Jogja Solo in a transaction worth more than 50% of its latest audited net assets. It will also seek approval to change the planned use of proceeds from its second rights issue, with the changes valued at more than 10% of total offering proceeds.

capital_raising_buybacks.event: TOBA secures up to S$555 million investment for Asian waste-management expansion
capital_raising_buybacks.headline: TOBA plans to raise up to S$555 million for Asian waste expansion
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: Funds managed by HPS Investment Partners would be channeled through SBTH Asia Holdings in staged issuances of preferred shares and warrants, with TOBA retaining control. Shareholder approval is scheduled for 27 November 2026.

capital_raising_buybacks.event: Sumber Global Energy repays its bond early
capital_raising_buybacks.headline: SGER repays Rp273.64 billion bond early
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: Sumber Global Energy used internal cash to settle its Series A bond, which carried a fixed 10% annual coupon and was due on 25 October. It also issued Rp9.46 billion of Series B bonds at 10.75%, maturing on 15 October 2027.
